summary.text: Sam Page is the Republican candidate for North Carolina State Senate District 26 in the November 3, 2026 general election, against Democrat Steve Luking.
A U.S. Air Force veteran and longtime Rockingham County sheriff, he won the March 3, 2026 Republican primary over incumbent Phil Berger by 13,135 votes to 13,112.

paragraphs.text: Sam Page graduated from Reidsville High School in 1975 and served in the U.S. Air Force from 1975 to 1980 as a security forces K-9 handler.
His career experience includes working as a patrolman, criminal investigator and administrator.
He was elected sheriff of Rockingham County, North Carolina, in 1998 and held that office as of 2024.
Page lost the 2024 Republican primary for Lieutenant Governor of North Carolina.
In 2026 he ran for the state senate seat held by Berger and advanced from the Republican primary.

His 2024 campaign website listed public safety, the economy, education and conservative leadership as priorities, including raising teacher pay to meet national standards and supporting school safety funding.
